title: Trossen/Interbotix WidowX 250 s - ROS 2 Jazzy

entry.sim_note: The jazzy branch only has a Gazebo Classic launch file (interbotix_xsarm_sim xsarm_gz_classic.launch.py); Gazebo Classic does not exist for ROS 2 Jazzy / Ubuntu 24.04, so there is no official Gazebo (Harmonic) simulation.

moveit.title: MoveIt 2 with fake hardware
moveit.cmd: ros2 launch interbotix_xsarm_moveit xsarm_moveit.launch.py robot_model:=wx250s hardware_type:=fake
moveit.status_reason: Not used by the course lessons; its simulation is being checked against real ROS 2 Jazzy (owner decision 2026-10-23).

rviz.title: Robot model in RViz
rviz.cmd: ros2 launch interbotix_xsarm_descriptions xsarm_description.launch.py robot_model:=wx250s use_joint_pub_gui:=true
rviz.status_reason: Not used by the course lessons; its simulation is being checked against real ROS 2 Jazzy (owner decision 2026-10-23).

fake.title: Control stack with fake hardware
fake.cmd: ros2 launch interbotix_xsarm_control xsarm_control.launch.py robot_model:=wx250s hardware_type:=fake

real.title: Real WidowX 250 s (interbotix_xs_sdk)
real.then: ros2 launch interbotix_xsarm_moveit xsarm_moveit.launch.py robot_model:=wx250s hardware_type:=actual
real.needs: a WidowX 250 s on USB (U2D2) with the udev rules from interbotix_xs_sdk
real.notes: interbotix_ros_core needs its git submodules (dynamixel_workbench_toolbox, interbotix_xs_driver): vcs import --recursive fetches them.
real.status_reason: Not used by the course lessons; its simulation is being checked against real ROS 2 Jazzy (owner decision 2026-10-23).

steps: sudo apt install python3-vcstool python3-colcon-common-extensions python3-rosdep
sudo cp src/interbotix_ros_core/interbotix_ros_xseries/interbotix_xs_sdk/99-interbotix-udev.rules /etc/udev/rules.d/ && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger

honesty: The site runs these real launch files, YAML, URDF/xacro and SDF files in the browser and models the programs they start (gz sim, controller_manager, move_group, Nav2 servers ...) in JavaScript. It cannot run the compiled C++ nodes. On a real Ubuntu 24.04 + ROS 2 Jazzy machine the same workspace builds and runs with the steps below.
pruned: Only the mesh/texture files used by the robots and worlds listed in 'gallery' and the entries are shipped (vcs import gets the complete repositories).
